name: holdup
description: HoldUp: hands-free label assistant for low-vision users on Meta AI glasses, powered by Gemini Live

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm -w server run dev" "npm -w web run dev"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm -w server run start
scripts.typecheck: npm -w server run typecheck && npm -w web run typecheck
